stem: What is the purpose of a grommet in mastoiditis?

options.text: To relieve middle ear pressure and ventilate the middle ear
To predict whether the fluid will resolve
To demonstrate that inflammation is absent
To prevent all future episodes of acute otitis media
To prove that no abscess is present

explanation: Grommet insertion is used to relieve middle ear pressure and ventilate the middle ear in mastoiditis.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes

optionExplanations.A: Correct because a grommet helps relieve middle ear pressure and ventilate the middle ear.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because a grommet does not predict whether middle ear fluid will resolve.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because a grommet does not demonstrate absence of inflammation.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because a grommet does not prevent all future episodes of acute otitis media.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because a grommet does not prove that no abscess is present.
